scopeDefinitions.IN_SCOPE_VISIBLE_REGION: Pimple is located on an exposed facial ROI within the product-accepted pose (FRONT, RIGHT, or LEFT) and within the analysis bounding crop.
scopeDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_EXTREME_POSE: Image does not satisfy product pose contracts (roll > 0.15, extreme pitch, or yaw outside FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT boundaries).
scopeDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_OCCLUDED_SIDE: Image is taken at a side profile angle (RIGHT or LEFT), and the lesion is on the occluded opposite cheek or non-exposed facial region.
scopeDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_OUTSIDE_CROP: Lesion center lies outside the adaptive facial analysis crop bounds.
scopeDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_NON_FACIAL: Lesion center lies outside the facial oval mask (e.g. neck, ear, hairline margin).
scopeDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_LANDMARK_FAILED: MediaPipe failed to extract 468 facial landmarks.
